programme.title: Toks & Tjops
programme.desc: 'S16/E34'. Een ding is seker, Suid-Afrikaners is mal daaroor om te braai en rugby te kyk! Ons paneelprogram verken alle sportgebeure wat die vorige week plaasgevind het en die wat elke naweek voorl.

programme.title: Bou Of Breek
programme.desc: 'S2/E3'. Klein veranderinge, groot verskil! Pikkie en Zanelle gee saam met die Meiring-gesin hul geliefde strandhuis in St Francisbaai 'n mooi, vars voorkoms met slim idees en kreatiewe opgraderings.

programme.title: Die Toring
programme.desc: 'S1/E33'. 'n Spanbou-dag by MPI plaas druk op Stella en Theo se verhouding. Ryan se onsekerheid maak hom roekeloos, maar Gabby gee hom iets om oor na te dink.

programme.title: Renboogrant
programme.desc: 'S2/E14 - Skoonveld'. Shani moet haarself bewys na die toneelstuk fiasko. Barnard en Johan se nuutgevonde vriendskap laat wenkbroue lig. Herman maak 'n oordeelsfout met Milan.

programme.title: Bravo!
programme.desc: 'S17/E22'. Ons klop aan vir kuiers by die akteur Evan Hengst en prof Gerhard van Huyssteen. Dan gesels ons met die wenners van die SA Akademie vir Wetenskap en Kuns pryse.

programme.title: Buite Is Beter Met Petri
programme.desc: 'S1/E9'. Kardiovaskulre- of kragoefening? Di belangrike keuse waaroor jy moet besluit word ondersoek en verduidelik. Die niere en blaas se wisselwerking en gesondheid is onder die vergrootglas.

programme.title: Oud En Jonk
programme.desc: 'S1/E9'. Die wenners van twee vorige rondes baklei om in die kompetisie te bly en 'n plek in die halfeindronde te verseker, met kennis, geheue en taalvaardigheid wat tot die uiterste beproef word.

programme.title: eNuus

programme.title: Haas Se Gat

programme.title: The Heart Is A Muscle
programme.desc: By 'n braai raak 'n vyfjarige seun vir 'n rukkie weg. Sy pa se gewelddadige reaksie ontketen gebeure en bring geheime uit die verlede na vore. 'n Reis van selfontdekking volg.

programme.title: Fista

programme.title: Taktiek

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung.

programme.title: Knockout
programme.desc: A retired boxer tries to help a new student who is being targeted by bullies.

programme.title: The Tigers
programme.desc: Five cops find their careers and their lives in jeopardy when they accept a 10 million dollar bribe from a drug smuggler, to release him from custody during a drug bust.

programme.title: Two Champions Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Two young warriors from the rebel Shaolin Clan are engaged in a deadly secret mission that could bring down the empire.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The film pays tribute to generations of stuntmen, including current super stars, who designed and delivered some of the most spectacular death-defying kung fu moves on-screen.

programme.title: 3AM The Office
programme.desc: A newcomer offends the ghosts in his office on his first day at work and experiences spooky encounters during night shifts, making him reflect on his behaviour.

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: In 1933, during the Defence of the Great Wall, seven Chinese soldiers defend the outpost of Badaolouzi against overwhelming Japanese forces in a heroic last stand.

programme.title: 3AM The Hospital
programme.desc: A woman in hospital discovers her husband's affair and encounters another victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit?

programme.title: Valley Of The Fangs
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, tries to protect another hero's wife and daughter from a corrupt minister's murderous plans.

programme.title: Blind Detective
programme.desc: A blind former detective, who possesses an uncanny ability to solve cold cases for rewards from the police, teams up with a detective in search of her missing friend.

programme.title: Disciples Of The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Hiding from a Manchu lord, a man is forced to seek refuge in a Shaolin temple, but he is no match for the creator of the 36th Chamber of Shaolin.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Manchu Emperor employs some top boxers to destroy Shaolin Temple. Almost all the Shaolin disciples were killed, but the survivors now band together to seek revenge.

programme.title: Clean My Name, Mr Coroner
programme.desc: An undercover cop framed for murder is forced to take a coroner hostage so as to prove his innocence in the murder of his partner.

programme.title: Kung Fu Monster
programme.desc: The Bruneian Empire in the Ming Dynasty offers a monster as a gift. Despite its gentle nature, the Guard Ocean releases the monster, sparking a frantic hunt for the royal bounty.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Rebellious Na Cha kills the Dragon King's son, sparking divine wrath. After a sacrifice, he is reborn more powerful than ever and rises to fight for justice.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Dr Lam diagnoses the latest phenomenon as more citizens become 'infected'. He decides to stop the vampires from turning more citizens.

programme.title: Endless Battle
programme.desc: Two brothers, one a drug lord and the other a police officer, clash in an endless battle between good and evil in a drug cartel's turf war.

programme.title: Playboy Cops
programme.desc: Two eccentric young detectives search for a killer to bring him to justice while vying for the affections of a young woman.

programme.title: The Sniper
programme.desc: A police sniper teams up with a hot-headed rookie to take down his former friend and teammate who is exacting revenge on the police.

programme.title: Helios
programme.desc: When the notorious criminal, Helios steals a powerful weapon from South Korea and attempts to sell it in Hong Kong, the police forces of these two lands must join hands.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwangtung
programme.desc: Anti-Ch'ing revolutionary leader, Chai Min Yu, is being hunted down by Manchu General Liang. He is almost caught when a masked man rescues him from death and escapes with him.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Heir to a demon-hunting clan, Ma Xiao Ling teams up with Kuang Tian You, a vampire posing as an immortal detective, to stop shadow attacks and resolve a century-old feud.

programme.title: Century of the Dragon
programme.desc: An undercover detective is assigned to take down a triad boss. However, he instead develops a friendship with the crime lord and is soon torn between duty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: An underground boxer loses his memory while escaping from the Bangkok triad. When he regains his memory after starting anew, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: The Monkey King emerges after the Goddess Nuwa's sacrifice to challenge the Jade Emperor. This leads to chaos that enables Buffalo Demon to wage war in heaven.

programme.title: Gun N' Rose
programme.desc: A Taiwanese gang boss names his adopted son Long Yi as his successor. This provokes Long Er (his biological son) to murder his father. Long Yi must now confront Long Er in a final battle.

programme.title: Bruce Lee, My Brother
programme.desc: A Bruce Lee biopic as told by his younger brother Robert. Following Bruce Lee's journey from a defiant youth in Hong Kong to his global triumph as an 18-year-old in the USA.

programme.title: The Heroic Trio
programme.desc: Newborn babies destined to be emperors are kidnapped by the Evil Master. The police are powerless, so the city must be saved by three women with superb fighting skills.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: A high class prostitute (Shih Szu) uses a famous swordsman (Ti Lung) and a thief (Fu Sheng) to take revenge on the 'Killer Doctor' who betrayed her brother many years ago.

programme.title: Martial Arts Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Jet Li weasels out of the Shaolin temple to assassinate a despotic ruler at the ruler's extravagant public birthday celebration.

programme.title: Relentless Fury
programme.desc: Lin Lang and his mercenary squad must protect a mysterious Chinese woman from assassins worldwide and a notorious fugitive, all drawn by a record-breaking bounty.
